File Manager App (https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.transsion.filemanagerx)
Comes with 3 analytics/ads trackers (https://reports.exodus-privacy.eu.org/fr/reports/com.transsion.filemanagerx/latest/)
It doesn't break anything upon disable, and uses telemetry. Similar to Google Files. Probably safe to disable. Further testing needed.
